rationale.test-only: A module nothing but its own test imports. Either wire it, delete it, or say here why it stays.
rationale.test-export: An exported symbol with no reference from any non-test file -- not even from its own module. Its tests pass, so the suite looks healthy, but nothing the product ships calls it. Clearing one means: wire it into a real code path, or drop the export and move the test with it. Three entries in this class were the reason the check exists -- purgeOrphanedAttachments, deleteAttachment and auditAttachmentIntegrity, the last two of which were removed rather than baselined.

notes.test-only:src/lib/legacyCrypto.ts:: Deliberate fail-closed tombstone, not an oversight. The module header says DO NOT USE and every export throws LegacyCryptoError; it exists so that an import of the removed pure-JS crypto primitives fails loudly instead of silently falling back. Keeping it and keeping its tests is the point -- deleting it would restore nothing and remove the marker. Revisit only if a migration build no longer needs the import to resolve.

notes.test-export:src/lib/folders.ts:ancestors: Tree helper. folders.ts builds the same walk inline; the exported copy has drifted into test-only territory. Either use it in the module or delete it with its test.

notes.test-export:src/lib/smartFolders.ts:ensu: Builtin preset registration helper. smartFolders.ts seeds its presets through a different path; this is a second way to do the same thing, which is the shape worth removing.
notes.test-export:src/lib/tags.ts:ensureTagsEx: Same shape as ensureBuiltInPresents: a helper the module no longer routes through.
notes.test-export:src/lib/fuzzySearch.ts:isFuz: SUSPECT, not scaffolding. fuzzySearch.ts is the search path for every list in the app and nothing in it calls isFuzzyMatch. Either it is dead weight left from an earlier matcher, or a predicate the current search is not using. Needs a decision.
SUSPECT, security-relevant. The write path computes the state integrity HMAC, but nothing outside vaultDatabaseFormat.ts calls the verifier. If the read path is meant to reject a state whose HMAC does not match, that check is currently only exercised by tests. Do not baseline this without answering that.
notes.test-export:src/lib/emergencyKit.ts:save: SUSPECT. The emergency kit is the user's only copy of the Secret Key, and no production path calls this export. If the PDF variant is unreachable, the kit the app actually offers is a different function and this one is a dead branch.
notes.test-export:src/lib/passkey.ts:unwrapPas: SUSPECT, security-relevant. Nothing outside passkey.ts unwraps a wrapped passkey private key. Biometric unlock and passkey registration must be unwrapping through something else; confirm they are not supposed to route through this.
notes.test-export:src/lib/indexedDbStorage.ts:: SUSPECT. Storage reads through the synchronous getIndexedDbItemSync path everywhere in production; this async reader has no caller. If it is the fallback for a browser without a sync API, that fallback is not wired.
notes.test-export:src/lib/vaultSession.ts:hasA: Session state predicate that storage.ts does not consult. storage.ts branches on the credential it is handed, so this may be genuinely redundant -- or the branch that needs it is missing.
notes.test-export:src/lib/vaultSession.ts:with: Same shape as hasActiveBackupPassword: a session accessor with no production reader.
notes.test-export:src/lib/vaultIntegrityLedger: Ledger helper with no production caller. The ledger is written on the paths that seal state; nothing lowers a mark afterwards. Confirm that is intended rather than a missing restore path.
notes.test-export:src/lib/passkeyAssertion.ts:: Encoding helper. Its siblings were consolidated into src/lib/common/bytes.ts during P2-4, and this one was left behind exporting its own copy. Deleting it is the consistent move.
notes.test-export:src/lib/passwordHistory.ts:c: SUSPECT, retention-relevant. recordPasswordHistory runs on every password change, but nothing in the app ever clears the history. If the cap in recordPasswordHistory drops old entries, clearing is redundant; if it does not, password history grows for the life of the item.
notes.test-export:src/lib/secureStorage.ts:set: Result-shaping helper for the secure-storage bridge. secureStorage.ts assembles its return values inline instead. Check whether the inline path and this helper disagree about the failure shape.
notes.test-export:src/lib/secureStorage.ts:res: Test-support hook, named for what it is. Resets module-level in-memory desktop secure storage cache and support flag for test isolation.
notes.test-export:src/lib/secureStorage.ts:set: Test-support hook, named for what it is. Seeds desktop secure storage cache directly in unit tests without invoking native Tauri IPC.
notes.test-export:src/lib/legacyCrypto.ts:reje: Part of the deliberate fail-closed tombstone; see the test-only entry for the same module.
notes.test-export:src/lib/vaultStorageProvider: Migration plumbing used by the wa-sqlite orchestration tests. The production migration path goes through the shared runner instead. Left baselined rather than deleted because wa-sqlite promotion is still gated and this is part of that surface.
